title: MicroVQA: A Multimodal Reasoning Benchmark for Microscopy-Based Scientific Research

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting no-image and choices-only ablation studies to evaluate if models use linguistic shortcuts and unimodal text priors to guess the correct multiple-choice answers without relying on visual reasoning.

Analyzing the relative accuracy drop between different MLLMs on questions generated by specific LLMs (RefineBot) to detect whether the adversarial refinement process introduces an evaluation bias against models from the same provider.
